snippet.title: The Spell Brigade - Official Launch Trailer | PS5 & Steam
snippet.description:
The Spell Brigade is OUT NOW - 1.0 on Steam and PlayStation 5!
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017532/
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2904000/The_Spell_Brigade/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=sm&utm_campaign=10&utm_content=launchtrailer_en

Survivors-like with ONLINE CO-OP for 1-4 players. Team up with your wizard friends to slay hordes of dark creatures. Complete team-based objectives, unlock new upgrades and create overpowered spell synergies. Friend nor foe is safe in this friendly fire bullet heaven!

The Spell Brigade channels:
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/DyKs6GMPSG
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@thespellbrigade
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thespellbrigade/
X: https://x.com/thespellbrigade
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/boltblastergames.bsky.social
